hero.headline: It only happens once. Make sure something stays.
hero.copy: Photo and video for concerts, exhibitions, artist sessions and brand events in Berlin, delivered ready for press.

detail.story: We followed the work from the first moments through the details that make the night memorable. A considered mix of atmosphere, people and place creates a lasting record for the team and its audience.

videos.title: Metaxy
videos.description: An immersive dance performance by Leonis Works, choreographed by Renato De Leon.
videos.context: Leonis Works · Choreography by Renato De Leon
story: Leonis Works, the dance company of Berlin choreographer Renato De Leon, explores the space between order and chaos, drawing on Nietzsche’s The Birth of Tragedy.
Four performers move among the audience rather than on a stage, while Berghain resident Norman Nodge mixes the music live.
videos.highlight: Between order and chaos, discipline and desire.

videos.title: Leonis Work & VOO Space
videos.description: World premiere of AGAPE at VOO Space.
videos.context: Dance, fashion and art exhibition, VOO Space Berlin
story: AGAPE had its world premiere at VOO Space: dance, fashion and art sharing one room, one night.
We stayed close to the movement and the garments, shooting for stills that hold the energy of a first performance and work long after it.
videos.highlight: A premiere only happens once. The images are what carry it forward.

videos.title: Mirrwal & Liquidrom
videos.description: Live beatbox under the Liquidrom dome.
story: Ukrainian beatbox artist Mirrwal performed live under the Liquidrom dome, sound bouncing off water and concrete.
We worked with the venue's low, coloured light instead of against it, keeping the room's atmosphere in every frame.

videos.title: Leonis Work & Liquidrom
videos.description: Four dancers, two live performances at Liquidrom.
story: Four dancers, two live performances, one dome. DOME 36 brought Leonis Work into the water and light of Liquidrom.
A short film and a set of stills follow the choreography from first entrance to the final pose in the pool.
videos.highlight: Movement, water and light, held still for a moment.

videos.title: Lick the walls to understand echoes
story: A sound installation is hard to photograph: the work lives in the air. We looked for the moments where it became visible.
The result is a press set and an archive of the space, made to explain the piece to people who weren't in the room.
videos.highlight: Making something you hear into something you can see.

videos.title: Abigail Toll, IDOL, Silent Green
story: Abigail Toll and IDOL shared the stage at Silent Green for a multi-artist night, documented from soundcheck to the last song.
A recap film and press stills give every act its own moment, and the night as a whole a story.
videos.highlight: One night, several artists, one coherent record.

videos.title: SANAM at Silent Green Berlin
story: SANAM in the Betonhalle at Silent Green: stage, crowd and the room itself, all part of the show.
Press stills and short social content, delivered fast enough to use while the night was still being talked about.
videos.highlight: The room is part of the performance.

videos.title: Seefeel at Silent Green Berlin
story: Seefeel's show in the Betonhalle, covered from the front of the stage to the back of the crowd.
Press-ready stills and footage that keep the band's layered, hazy sound in the pictures.

videos.title: GLEO at Silent Green Berlin
story: GLEO live at Silent Green, captured in photo and video in one pass.
A compact set of stills and clips, edited for press, the artist's channels and the venue's own archive.
videos.highlight: Photo and video from one visit, one consistent look.
